service_boundary: Represents the AI/ML API reselling service, not the labs whose models it forwards to.
regional_controls: No customer control over processing geography is documented.
retention_controls: The privacy policy states no retention period beyond keeping data as long as necessary, and no position on training over customer prompts is documented.
routing: Requests reach a named model through one compatible endpoint; provider selection, fallback, and steering controls are not documented.
customization: No customer fine-tuning or private deployment is documented.
strengths: A single compatible endpoint reaches an unusually broad multimodal catalogue spanning text, image, video, and voice vendors.
Response headers report spend per request, making cost attribution possible without a separate metering system.
tradeoffs: Per-token rates are the operator's own and sit consistently above the rates other aggregators publish for the same models, with no statement anywhere of how they relate to upstream pricing.
The terms promise to carry a last-updated date and carry none, and no position on training over customer prompts is stated.
Subscription tiers and the paused free tier are visible only after signing in.
